name: ste-translator
title: STE Translator
description: Rewrite English text as Simplified Technical English (ASD-STE100 principles) using AI, with protected technical content.
author: rajasimman_s

commands.name: convert-selected
commands.title: Convert Selected Text to STE
commands.description: Rewrite the selected text in the frontmost application as Simplified Technical English.

commands.name: convert-clipboard
commands.title: Convert Clipboard Text to STE
commands.description: Read the clipboard, edit it, and rewrite it as Simplified Technical English.

commands.name: convert-text
commands.title: Convert Text to STE
commands.description: Type or paste text and rewrite it as Simplified Technical English.

preferences.name: defaultContentType
preferences.title: Default Content Type
preferences.description: Content type used when none is chosen.

preferences.name: defaultMode
preferences.title: Default Conversion Mode
preferences.description: Conversion mode used when none is chosen.

preferences.name: provider
preferences.title: AI Provider
preferences.description: Raycast AI (default) or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Text is sent to the provider and is subject to its data policy.

preferences.name: raycastModel
preferences.title: Raycast AI Model
preferences.description: Model used with Raycast AI. A stronger model follows the STE rules more reliably. Raycast's own default (GPT-4o mini) is weaker at this task.

preferences.name: externalBaseUrl
preferences.title: External Provider Base URL
preferences.description: For example https://api.openai.com/v1. Used only with the OpenAI-compatible provider.

preferences.name: externalModel
preferences.title: External Provider Model
preferences.description: Model name sent to the external provider.

preferences.name: externalApiKey
preferences.title: External Provider API Key
preferences.description: Stored by Raycast. Never written to disk by this extension.

preferences.name: customInstructions
preferences.title: Custom Instructions
preferences.description: Optional extra rules, such as preferred terms. They cannot override the preservation rules.

preferences.name: timeoutSeconds
preferences.title: Timeout (seconds)
preferences.description: Maximum wait for the AI provider.
